title: Activity log — the cross-agent state bus
description: Append-only, newest first. Every agent writes one entry per run; interactive sessions write one per consequential outcome.

timestamp.description: UTC, ISO 8601. When the run finished.

agent.description: Stable identifier matching the agent filename. Interactive sessions use a reserved name such as 'session'.

run.description: Monotonic per agent. Gaps are visible and meaningful.

action.description: One line: what this run did, including the verdict.

details.description: The numbers. Counts, prices, paths, identifiers. Other agents reason from this field.

affects.description: Agents or workstreams that should care. Routing hint.

decisions.description: One or two judgment calls as 'chose X over Y because Z'. The drift-detection record.
